question_text: What was the net person flow (person_entry events minus person_exit events) at Gate_MainEntrance on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event {event_type: 'person_entry'})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location {name: 'Gate_MainEntrance'})
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN count(e) AS count_entries
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (e:Event {event_type: 'person_exit'})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Location {name: 'Gate_MainEntrance'})
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN -count(e) AS count_exits
}
RETURN sum(count_entries + count_exits) AS net_person_flow
